tasks.title: Conversation #84
tasks.transcript:
Woman: Hey, did you end up making it to Janet's concert last night?
Man: I was planning to go, but I got completely sidetracked helping my cousin move into her new apartment. It took way longer than expected.
Woman: That's too bad, it was incredible. She added a saxophonist to her band, you would have loved it.
Man: I knew I was missing something special. I hope she'll play again soon.
Woman: I think she'll be at the Spring Festival in a couple weeks, so don't make any other plan.

questions.stem: Why did the man miss an event?

options.C: He was helping a family member.

questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：男士为什么错过了一个活动？ 定位原文： Man: I was planning to go, but I got completely sidetracked helping my cousin move into her new apartment. 选项分析： A. He forgot about it. 他忘记了。因为男士明确提到他原本计划去，但因帮忙搬家中途分心，并非遗忘，所以A选项错误。 B. He had to work late. 他不得不工作到很晚。对话中未提及工作原因，所以B选项错误。 C. He was helping a family member. 他在帮助一位家人。男士提到帮助他的 cousin（表/堂兄弟姐妹）搬家，属于家庭成员，所以C选项正确。 D. He couldn't get tickets. 他买不到票。对话中未提及票务问题，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What does the woman encourage the man to do?

options.B: Introduce her to a music teacher

questions.analysis: 答案：D 题目问的是：女士鼓励男士做什么？ 定位原文： Woman: I think she'll be at the Spring Festival in a couple weeks, so don't make any other plan. 选项分析： A. Create a concert poster 制作音乐会海报。对话中没有提到海报制作，所以A选项错误。 B. Introduce her to a music teacher 把她介绍给一位音乐老师。对话中没有提到音乐老师，所以B选项错误。 C. Listen to a recording 听录音。对话中没有提到录音，所以C选项错误。 D. Attend a festival 参加一个节日活动。女士提到 Janet 几周后会出现在春季庆典（Spring Festival），并让男士不要做其他安排，暗示他应该去参加，所以D选项正确。
